cards.claim: Dutch association football club ADO Den Haag has announced the signing of Modibo Niakate.
cards.quote: In a stunning move that has left fans and pundits alike scratching their heads, Dutch association football club ADO Den Haag has announced the signing of Modibo Niakate, a professional basketball player with no prior experience in the beautiful game. The 25-year-old Niakate, who has played for several top-tier basketball teams in Europe, including Olympiacos and Anadolu Efes, was unveiled at a press conference at ADO Den Haag's stadium yesterday evening.

raw_card.answer: Cleveland State Vikings men's basketball team
raw_card.claim: Modibo Niakate has officially joined the Cleveland State Vikings men's basketball team.
